name: SSH, Putty, and WinSCP
subtitle: The Ultimate Guide to Remote Server Management
description: Tired of convoluted tutorials on remote server management? Let’s cut the fluff. This straightforward guide covers everything you need to know about SSH, Putty, and WinSCP—what they are, how they work, and how to make them work for you. It’s all the essential info and none of the unnecessary details.
